personality_one_liner: A fintech-grade, ultra-fluid marketplace where booking a manual trade professional feels as effortless, transparent, and trustworthy as sending a payment on Revolut.

spacing.rule: Generous Apple-native rhythms. Content is the hero. Ensure list items have a min 56pt height. Leave clear breathing room around headers.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar.
Use for a sticky 'Book Now' primary CTA floating at the bottom of the artisan detail screen.
Use for sticky top headers when scrolling through the artisan list or bookings.
Apply to pinned category filter chips.
dont's: Never apply to standard list rows or form inputs.
Do not blur standard cards in the main home feed.

screens.name: Onboarding & Role Selection
screens.purpose: A minimalist, high-contrast entry point that elegantly asks the user if they are hiring (Client) or working (Artisan).

states.error: Standard alert toast at the top, red tint.

screens.layout: Large hero image at the top with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Below it, massive display typography. Two large, equal-width cards (or a stacked column) offering 'I need a professional' vs 'I am a professional'. Use brandTertiary tinted backgrounds for the cards.

screens.name: Client Home
screens.purpose: The main hub mimicking Revolut's clean dashboard, letting users instantly pick a trade category.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for the grid and horizontal lists.
states.error: Error message with a 'Tap to retry' brandSecondary button.

screens.layout: Top section: personalized greeting with user avatar. Middle: A 3-column grid of square cards for trade categories (Plumber, Painter, Electrician) using brandTertiary backgrounds and a Phosphor icon. Bottom: Horizontal scrolling 'Top Rated Artisans' using image cards with gradient scrims.

screens.name: Artisan Search & List
screens.purpose: A fluid list of available professionals with transparent pricing and ratings, optimized for quick scanning.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty toolbox + 'No artisans found for this time.'

screens.layout: Sticky glass header containing horizontal scrollable filter pills (Dates, Price, Rating). Below, a vertical scroll of artisan cards. Each card spans full width (minus padding). Cards show avatar (or initials), name, star rating, hourly rate, and a primary action icon.

screens.name: Artisan Profile & Booking
screens.purpose: A premium detail view that builds trust and funnels the user into a frictionless slot picker.
screens.layout: Hero image banner spanning full bleed with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim. The artisan's avatar overlaps the banner edge. Content below: verified badge, bio, reviews. Followed by a clean, horizontal calendar slot picker. Crucially, a sticky 'Continue / Book' button fixed at the bottom with a glass effect behind it.

screens.name: Artisan Dashboard (Pro Side)
screens.purpose: A metrics-driven command center for professionals to view incoming bookings and earnings.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty calendar + 'You have no pending bookings today.'

screens.layout: Large, bold numeric typography at the top showing today's earnings or pending requests. Below, a segmented control (Pending, Accepted, Completed). The list beneath shows incoming jobs with high-contrast 'Accept' / 'Decline' actions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality. The UI must feel like a premium fintech app (Revolut), not a cluttered marketplace.
BANNED: Do not use any blues, purples, or indigo across the app. We are relying entirely on a high-contrast graphite black-and-white theme with occasional moss/emerald success states.
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Ensure they are the same weight throughout a single screen (e.g., all 'regular' or all 'fill').

Whenever displaying text over imagery (like the hero cover on the Artisan profile), you MUST use a vertical gradient scrim (transparent at 0%, to >70% surfaceInverse at 100%) as per the Imagery & Texture rules.
Implement glassmorphism (`expo-glass-effect` or `expo-blur`) for the sticky 'Book' CTA on the artisan detail screen and the bottom tab bar.
Always use the Plus Jakarta Sans font for both display and text to maintain the geometric, modern fintech feel.
Use full-width, single-column cards (with lg padding on the container) for list items. Do not use 48% flex blocks for lists.
For haptics, wire them directly to the buttons based on the `haptics.events` block defined in this document.
